ring-telemetryops.name: Ring TelemetryOps
ring-telemetryops.summary: Diagnostic agent for Ring video doorbells, built for the Amazon Developer Hackathon 2026. OpenCV measures the stream, a deterministic pre-check sets the severity, and Claude Haiku 4.5 on Amazon Bedrock reasons over the evidence. A local fallback keeps the same report contract when Bedrock is unavailable.

hybrid-rag-api.name: Hybrid RAG API
hybrid-rag-api.summary: A hybrid RAG engine written from scratch, without LangChain or LlamaIndex. Dense search (pgvector, HNSW) and lexical search (PostgreSQL GIN) are fused with Reciprocal Rank Fusion, and the prompt requires a document-and-page citation for every claim.
hybrid-rag-api.fact: RRF with k = 60 over HNSW and GIN

wakemap.summary: Flutter prototype from my dissertation: location-based alarms with geofencing, voice-created alarms and an AI travel guide. A Node.js/Express proxy keeps the Gemini key on the server.

generate.title: Three systems, from the inside
generate.lead: What each one solves and the decisions that shaped it. The details live in each repository.

ring-telemetryops.tagline: Measure first, reason second: OpenCV grades the stream, and Claude on Bedrock only steps in when something is wrong.
decisions: Pay for reasoning only when needed
ring-telemetryops.diagramDesc: A camera stream is measured by OpenCV, graded by a deterministic pre-check, and only anomalies reach knowledge-base retrieval and Claude on Bedrock; a local fallback keeps the same report contract.
steps: A frame from the camera stream (or the Digital Twin simulator) is analysed by OpenCV: frame rate, bitrate, brightness, sharpness and banding.
A deterministic pre-check grades each metric against thresholds kept in one JSON file.
Nominal results return a healthy report without calling the model.
Anomalies trigger ranking of 15 troubleshooting procedures by the measured signals.
Claude Haiku 4.5 on Amazon Bedrock reasons over the keyframe, metrics and procedures.
The answer is validated against a report contract with one corrective retry.
If Bedrock is unavailable, a local fallback produces the same report schema, labelled as such.

hybrid-rag-api.tagline: Answers over PDFs where every claim cites its document and page, built from scratch without LangChain.
decisions: RRF instead of a weighted sum
hybrid-rag-api.diagramDesc: PDFs are chunked and embedded into PostgreSQL; each question runs vector and full-text search in parallel, fuses them with RRF and asks Gemini for an answer with page citations.
steps: A PDF is uploaded through FastAPI and split by page, then into overlapping chunks.
Chunks are embedded with gemini-embedding-001 in batches, with exponential backoff on rate limits.
Text and vectors are stored in PostgreSQL 16 with an HNSW index and a GIN full-text index.
A question runs dense and lexical search concurrently.
Reciprocal Rank Fusion (k = 60) merges both rankings.
The top chunks and the conversation history go to Gemini at temperature 0.
The prompt requires a document-and-page citation for every claim.

wakemap.tagline: Location alarms that wake you before your stop, plus an AI travel guide. My dissertation prototype.
decisions: The key stays on the server
Structured output the app can trust
wakemap.diagramDesc: The Flutter app handles alarms, voice input and maps on the device and calls a Node.js proxy for Gemini; maps and routes come from OpenStreetMap, Nominatim and OSRM.
steps: The Flutter app runs two modes: commuter alarms and a traveller guide.
Commuter alarms use geofencing with a 100 to 1,000 m radius and fire local notifications.
Spoken alarms are transcribed on the device and sent to the Node.js proxy.
The proxy, which holds the API key, asks Gemini for structured JSON.
Traveller plans come back with stops, coordinates, duration and budget.
Places are geocoded with Nominatim and routes drawn with OSRM on OpenStreetMap tiles.

output.title: The answer, in short
about: I'm Ernesto, an engineer who builds AI systems end to end: the retrieval, the agent, the backend around them and the tests that say what still breaks.

I graduated from York St John University in the UK with a First Class BSc (Hons), after a Higher Technician diploma in multiplatform app development in Spain. During my internship at CEU's IT Innovation department I worked on an AI tutor that connected institutional data in Snowflake with OpenAI models on Azure.
I'm based in Madrid, available now and open to relocation or hybrid work. I'm looking for AI Engineer, Forward Deployed Engineer and related roles.

points: Built an AI personal tutor that links institutional data in Snowflake with OpenAI APIs on Azure.
Optimised SQL joins, taking data retrieval from days to near-instant.
Used structured XML prompting to make outputs more deterministic.

agent.how: This agent is scripted and runs entirely in your browser. It scores your question against a small bilingual knowledge base with the same BM25 scorer used on this page, shows the real lookups it makes in local data, then streams a pre-written answer. No LLM, no network requests, nothing stored.
